# Third-party material

`.agents/skills/aws-*` contains unmodified text from AWS Agent Toolkit for AWS,
under Apache-2.0. The exact commit, file hashes and review date are recorded in
`aws-skills.lock.json`; license/notice are retained in this directory.
These are AWS general guidance, not a guarantee that a service is enabled in Academy.
Other reference repositories were inspected for design comparison; their application code was not copied.
